hardware.gles_context: OpenGL ES 3.2 with ES 2.0 API/GLSL ES 1.00 path

classification_notes.documented_numeric_rasterization_varianc: Differences remain relative to the driver fixed-function oracle. Targeted probes establish matrix and signed-normal numeric differences; inspected worst native differences lie on one-pixel primitive edges. No blanket tolerance is applied to the stored measurements. Evidence IDs describe applicable mechanisms, not a per-pixel causal proof.
classification_notes.compatibility_matrix_and_normal_precisio: CPU transforms and explicit normal conversion do not duplicate every numeric approximation of the NVIDIA fixed-function implementation. The shared shader uses the explicit current signed-normal conversion rather than encoding an unverified driver-specific implementation.
classification_notes.primitive_edge_coverage: OpenGL and explicit APIs may choose different coverage at primitive edges; worst native-versus-Core cases were isolated horizontal pixel rows.
classification_notes.clip_depth_rounding: Vulkan and D3D12 require a clip-depth range conversion absent from the GL path.
classification_notes.expanded_line_coverage: Native APIs without wide lines use shared pixel-width geometry. End/join coverage is not claimed bit-identical to every native line rasterizer.
